name: hud_ui_composite_panel_set_text_fmt_v
description: HudUiCompositePanel::SetTextFmtV formats the active composite entry, makes it visible, and scrolls history.
known_limits: No VC byte target covers 0x4bbac0 yet; tier S remains open for a later HUD composite-panel text source-file pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly at 0x4bbac0 validates active entry address calculation using activeEntryCount and HudUiCompositePanelEntry stride 0x2c0, entry SetTextFmtV dispatch through slot 34 (+0x88), entry SetVisible(1) dispatch through slot 24 (+0x60), and composite ScrollHistory dispatch through slot 37 (+0x94).

The native composite-panel text-format smoke verifies SetTextFmtV formats the active real transition-text entry, clears its hidden flag, triggers the overflow history shift when the entry vector fills, and invalidates the composite panel.
